semantic_description: Navigate and analyze source code through language-aware symbols and relationships, including definitions, references, implementations, imports, and call sites.
responsibilities: Resolve source-code symbols within a declared project scope.
Support impact analysis and symbol-preserving refactoring workflows.
non_responsibilities: Replacing project tests or review authority.
Installing or changing agent tooling implicitly.

informative.summary: Provider-neutral symbol navigation exposed to coding agents through a client adapter.
